name: MCP Server
description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server bridge for Super Productivity - lets Claude read and manage your tasks, projects and tags
author: ToYoNiX

changelog.1.0.0: Initial release with full MCP bridge functionality
changelog.1.1.0: Flatpak support (writability-probed data directory), dashboard renamed to MCP Server, dashboard path/status display fixed
changelog.1.2.0: Real task deletion via PluginAPI.deleteTask (Super Productivity 15+)
changelog.1.3.0: Dashboard: long paths wrap inside their card instead of colliding with labels
changelog.1.3.1: Fix 1.3.0 layout regression (stray columns on wide windows, values pushed to their own line)
changelog.1.4.0: Hook event files are capped (default 50) and swept at startup instead of accumulating forever
